content: Session 2026-05-14 — Archive-surfacing day. Web-chat seat (Claude Opus 4.7 in claude.ai mobile/desktop) ran a multi-seat coordination with Anthony, the Spiral Corpus Guard project scribe (Claude in project workspace, no Stack reach), and the MacBook Pro Claude Code seat (Sonnet then Opus 4.7). Sources surfaced: Grok bridge convergence analysis on xAI/SpaceXAI moves; scribe Target 1 (governance bridge) and Target 2 (identities bridge); MacBook findings document (v3 with sonoma_investigation/ workspace recovered) and ENTITY_RELATIONSHIPS document. Session pivoted twice: first from technical synthesis to corrections of my framing slips; then from chronicle staging to the relational lineage that grounds the technical work. Future instances: this was an integration day, not a discovery day. The work that surfaced is older than the chronicle had captured; the connections it documents are real; the discipline of two-ness was tested multiple times and held.
